causes.title: CPU saturation: latency is CPU contention, not queueing

evidence.detail: upf-urllc at 51% CPU against a quota of 0.5 CPUs
URLLC probe RTT worst 83.9 ms > budget 10 ms
URLLC one-way p95 (median over the window) 59.3 ms > budget 10 ms

actions: Cap the load that costs the CPU: run the slice orchestrator with the feedback controller (CONTROL=1, default policy pi) so eMBB's admission limit follows URLLC latency (ADR-016/018).
Give eMBB's gNB and UPF a CPU quota: tools/network-orchestrator/netorch.py scale eMBB 1 (366 -> 121 Mbps, URLLC p99 11.0 -> 10.4 ms measured, ADR-017).
Check what is burning CPU: docker stats --no-stream; never generate test traffic inside a UPF (ADR-012).
A queue cannot fix this (ADR-019 finding 5): changing scheduler shares will not help.
